source_location: Sections 2.3-2.4, 3.3-3.4; Table 3; Figure 8 specimen legend checked only for identity
LOI_source_location: Section 3.3 Flame Resistance and Durability; Table 3 initial LOI for FRC-20
conditions_source_location: Section 2.4 (Pyris 1; nitrogen/oxygen; 40-700°C; 20°C/min); Figure 8/results call oxidative condition air
pairing_evidence: Figure 8 explicitly labels the TG curves Control cotton and FRC-20, tying the Section 3.4 treated-cotton numeric text to FRC-20 rather than FRC-10 or FRC-15. Section 2.3 defines FRC-X by solution wt%; Section 3.3 and Table 3 give initial LOI. Both TGA and LOI are cotton fabric after preparation rinse and before durability laundering. Washed FRC-20 (50 LC; LOI44.6) is excluded.
verification_notes: Hold oxidative observations: methods say oxygen while results and Fig.8 caption say air; do not silently normalize O2 to air. Numeric residues explicit in text; source phrase weight loss 0 is contextually residual mass 0, also printed as (700,0) in Fig.8. No curve estimation.
crosswalk_notes: Existing B20260927-252/253 N2 match. B20260927-254/255 called air despite oxygen methods; those require source-conflict handling, not unconditional review.
